Idle Transfiguration — Cursed Technique Reversal

You have learned how to reverse your technique, allowing you to transfigure targets without souls. As a Bonus Action while holding or touching an object or weapon, you can spend Cursed Energy up to twice your proficiency bonus. For every 1 Cursed Energy spent, you can change one property of the object or to increase/decrease the size category of the object. The Special property costs 3 Cursed Energy instead of 1, and you must work with your DM to figure out its rules. These transfigurations last until you dismiss them as a Free Action while holding or touching the object.

Soul Splitting Weapon. At 6th level, you have learned to transfigure objects in a way to damage the souls of others. Once per turn when you hit a creature with a transfigured weapon, you can spend 4 CE to cause that creature to also suffer the effects of Transfiguration on a hit.
